query:
SELECT 
  cp.product_name,
  SUBSTRING(CAST(rea.results AS CHAR), 1, 2000) as results_preview
FROM competitor_products cp
JOIN reverse_engineering_analyses rea ON cp.id = rea.competitor_product_id
WHERE rea.analysis_type = 'performance_translation'
AND cp.product_name = 'PPG AMERCOAT 385'
LIMIT 1;
